meta.name: Generate Image (Qwen-Image-2.1)
meta.licenseNote: Qwen-Image-2.1 (Alibaba Qwen, 2026-09-20) ships under the Qwen Research License Agreement: research and evaluation use only; commercial use needs a separate agreement with Alibaba. Turn on Allow Research-Only Models in Preferences › AI Integrations to use it.
meta.promptFormatTransparent: {prompt}, isolated on a transparent background, output a PNG image
meta.notes: Node names and settings follow ComfyUI's official 'Text to Image (Qwen Image 2.1)' template (image_qwen_image_2_1_t2i.json): UNETLoader → QwenImage21Cache, CLIPLoader type qwen_image, TextEncodeQwenImage21 without images (positive and negative), EmptyLatentImage, KSampler euler/simple 25 steps CFG 1, VAEDecode. The optional prompt-enhancement encoder (qwen3.5_9b_qwen_image_2.1_pe_t2i) is left out. The 2.1 VAE decodes RGBA: asked for '…, isolated on a transparent background, output a PNG image' (promptFormatTransparent, the official background-removal template's phrasing) the saved PNG carries a real alpha channel (verified live 2026-10-09: a boat with a clean soft matte, 10 s at 1024²).
